_readme: The correction pairs that run AFTER the recognizer and BEFORE the paste. These are examples. Replace them with your own jargon, or leave them and put yours in ~/Library/Application Support/dictation/glossary.json, which is merged on top of this file and survives updates.
_how_it_works: A garble is matched EXACTLY after squashing case, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes. 'engine x' and 'Engine-X' and 'ENGINEX' all squash to 'enginex'. Nothing fuzzy, no edit distance, so an ordinary English word can never be rewritten into one of your terms.
_two_rules_worth_knowing: A one-word 'correct' with NO garbles is never registered at all. That is deliberate: it is how you list a term that is also an ordinary English word (Arc, Notion, Sonnet) without capitalizing every innocent use of it.
A garble that is ALSO another term's canonical form is dropped automatically (the cross-term fence). You cannot make two rows fight.
